sourceSentences: Irelia dashes 100 units through the target enemy's location, and upon collision or dash completion, she deals physical damage, applies on-hit effects, and heals herself.
Bladesurge's current cooldown is reduced to 0.2 seconds upon collision of targets marked as Unsteady, and is reset if the target dies to or during Bladesurge's dash.
Flawless Duet can be cast during the dash.
Bladesurge will be buffered and cast when the cooldown ends or is reset if the player attempts to cast it within 0.5 seconds of the cooldown ending/resetting.
Bladesurge will only allow Irelia to dash through walls if there is enough space for her on the other side.
Irelia will automatically be ordered to acquire and attack Bladesurge's target as soon as the dash completes.
Enemy champions and large monsters hit by Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge initial barrage are marked as Unsteady for 5 seconds.
Enemies that cross the perimeter are not marked Unsteady.
Flawless Duet can be recast after 0.15 seconds while the blade is active, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.
Irelia sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if Flawless Duet was recast automatically.
The outgoing blades will stop flight upon touching projectile blocking effects. The converging blades will instead be destroyed upon contact with such effects.
The blades will not stun nor deal damage if they fail to converge (i.e Wind Wall).
Defiant Dance's charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control.
Defiant Dance's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control. Ionian Fervor duration is paused during the charge
The blades will still expand if the champion hit by the blades is protected by a spell shield.
c'est que cela consiste essentiellement à utiliser votre touche Q comme une sorte de réinitialisation automatique
Mais si j'appuie sur Q juste au moment où mes dégâts automatiques se déclenchent, c'est beaucoup plus rapide.
il s'agit essentiellement de dissimuler votre E à l'intérieur de l'animation de votre Q afin que les ennemis ne puissent pas réagir. En gros, dès que vous faites une ruée, vous devez poser le E
s'il me fait un face-check, par exemple, je vais faire E, R, Q, puis le poursuivre, et ensuite essayer de placer mon E.
You can hide your first E exceptionally well behind other animations. For example, queuing on a minion like this. For this to work, you need to press E on top of the minion and immediately Q on it.
If you have good vision management and control, you can just hide your first E in a bush or behind the wall.
After you've placed your first E, you have 3.5 seconds until you have to place your second one. So, you do have time to act normal.
Pour les combos, commencez par le E puis l'ultime, enchaînez avec le A, qui sera réinitialisé par l'ultime, puis le E. Attaquez, utilisez le A qui sera réinitialisé par le E
Et utiliser le A sur une cible marquée supprime la marque et réinitialise instantanément le délai de récupération.
